# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.16 — Full hardening and lifecycle convergence

<!-- update-summary: Preview.16 converges service lifecycles, Smart Drag/OLE ownership, native callback safety, image budgets, local-network authority, and bounded cleanup while preserving the Preview.15 product boundary. -->

Preview.16 is a full-hardening release. It preserves the Windows 10 version 1809 (Build 17763) baseline, x64 release boundary, local-first storage, source-safe file references, Dynamic Island behavior, and the Preview.15 security contracts while closing remaining lifecycle and resource-boundary defects.

## Lifecycle, OLE, and native boundaries

- Secure-share QR previews render from memory after the explicit QR action; the URL fragment and master key are never written to generic temporary storage.
- Smart Drag suppression now blocks only candidate creation and promotion. Release, cancel, timeout, mode changes, placement editing, and shutdown always converge the active session.
- Virtual-file materialization owns the data before a non-async OLE `Drop` returns. Async-capable providers keep `EndOperation` in a guaranteed cleanup path, and ISTREAM/HGLOBAL reads remain bounded.
- Cross-device Clipboard, Device Handoff, and encrypted-share recovery commit initialization only after their resources are active and return to a retryable state after failure or cancellation.
- Settings changes roll back every committed subsystem independently and preserve the original forward-path exception. Clipboard subclass and global-hotkey callbacks isolate each managed subscriber; the hotkey grammar rejects ambiguous sequences.

## Decode, preview, and sharing hardening

- One Windows decoder preflight applies encoded-byte, dimensions, pixel-count, decoded-memory, and codec-working-set limits to local/remote clipboard images, Share Target data, previews, thumbnails, and transforms.
- PDF page count no longer comes from a full-file text heuristic. Media capability metadata is conservative, QR actions reject payloads beyond encoder capacity, and decoder failures use the existing safe fallback UI.
- DropLink, DNS-SD, and Nearby Share use one deterministic private IPv4 interface decision. Host and discovery lifecycles are serialized, Nearby receiver admission is atomic, and transfer finalization has a bounded lifetime.
- Revoke records prune on save with deterministic newest-record retention. Shared update operations outlive an individual caller's cancellation, and cleanup failures cannot replace the primary processing error.

## Validation boundary

The hosted Windows en-US/zh-CN CI and release workflow validate restore, Core/Infrastructure/App tests, WinUI Release build, portable EXE, installer lifecycle and `/UPDATE`, localized smoke, unsigned MSIX, release metadata, checksums, and website/API synchronization. This Preview remains **CONDITIONAL** for real Windows 10/11 OS and mixed-DPI behavior, Explorer and third-party OLE providers, accessibility and animation feel, two-device DropLink/Nearby acceptance, and operator-deployed Worker/browser acceptance. Those rows require evidence from matching real targets and are never inferred from hosted CI or source inspection.

## 中文说明

- Preview.16 是完整加固版本：二维码仅在明确操作后以内存渲染，Smart Drag 抑制不会吞掉终止信号，异步与非异步 OLE 虚拟文件都在正确的生命周期内取得数据。
- 跨设备剪贴板、设备交接、加密分享恢复和设置回滚均按实际资源提交、失败可重试；原生剪贴板/热键回调逐个隔离异常。
- 本地图像、远端图像、预览、缩略图、Share Target 和变换统一执行解码预算；DropLink、DNS-SD、Nearby 共享统一网卡决策并串行化生命周期。
- 托管 Windows CI 与发布工作流通过后，真机系统/DPI/OLE/无障碍、双设备网络和 Worker/浏览器验收仍保持 CONDITIONAL，不能由源代码或托管 CI 推断。

Preview assets may be unsigned. Download only from the official GitHub Release and verify `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview; select the Preview channel to test it.
